summary.text: Chris Paplauskas is a Republican member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives, representing District 15 since January 7, 2025, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, in a race that also includes Democrat Colleen Crudele and Independent Allan Fung.

paragraphs.text: Chris Paplauskas was born in Providence, Rhode Island.
Before his election to the state House he served on the Cranston City Council.
